liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help on the Way** (2 reviews): Reviewer prizes Help for its spacey quality, saying the band went far out; they played both Help and Terrapin; The band played the Help-Slip-Frank sequence, among the reviewer's favorite recorded songs [17][20]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (1 review): Reviewer finds West L.A. Fadeaway, Brother Esau and Brown-Eyed Women solid renditions in an otherwise sloppy, middling show [25]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): Garcia is clearly not listening to his bandmates in Slipknot!; vocals strained all night and Healy overuses delay pedal [23]
- **Iko-IKo** (1 review): Reviewer, at their first show, was thrilled when the band opened with Iko Iko, knowing only the Doctor John version [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-10-17.nak300.morris.113969.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 159 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1984-10-17.beyerm88.suraci.78015.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd84-10-17.nak.willy.15125.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 159 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates this audience recording 3.5 stars and says a better audience source exists from the same night [19]
- **gd1984-10-17.176253.senn441.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 167 min [9]
- **gd1984-10-17.sbd.miller.32057.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min; rated 2.7/5 by 10 [11]
- **gd84-10-17.set2-sbd.ladner.21783.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 88 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [14]. Said about its sound: Describes the soundboard as crisp and calls the second set intense, high-energy and jam-filled, despite some mostly verbal clunkers [18]

## Around the show

- Garcia's pale, heavy-set arm was spotlighted as he strummed the opening chords of Terrapin; the band faltered after the break [17]
- The spotlight fell on Garcia's pale, heavy arm during Terrapin's opening; reviewer jokes he was propped on his stool [21]
- Reviewer attributes the weak show to Garcia being in bad shape that year, not Weir's birthday [26]
- Reviewer stood twentieth row on the floor; the sound was so loud and distorted that they nearly retreated to the seats [27]
- Reviewer says the show gets undeserved criticism, citing a Relix review calling it sloppy and claiming Goin' Down the Road ended in a trainwreck [18]
- Reviewer calls this a pretty bad show, saying the band didn't seem like themselves [23]
- Reviewer saw the whole tour; this was a weaker night, the next was better, and Augusta, Hartford and Syracuse were hotter [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-10-17.nak300.morris.113969.flac24**: taped by Bob Morris; source: Nakamichi CM-300 (CP-1) x2 > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell XLII-S C-90) Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate… [1]. Also: Recorded by Bob Morris from Floor Section 7, Row Y, Seat 4; transferred October 2009 with 2496 conversion in January 2011; Tape flips in Drums are spliced at 1:53 and 6:40 [1]
- **gd1984-10-17.beyerm88.suraci.78015.flac16**: taped by Tony Suraci; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: Beyer M88>Sony D5 [2]. Also: Recorded with Beyer mics borrowed from Eugene; this is the 16-bit version, with 24-bit archived on DVDA [2]
- **gd84-10-17.nak.willy.15125.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD(Nak 300Âs)>MC>DAT>CD via Paul B encoded by Willy [8]
- **gd1984-10-17.176253.senn441.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master FOB (center) Audience Cassettes; (3) Sennheiser 441 mic blend > Nakamichi 550 [9]. Also: Patches fill 7 seconds of the Terrapin Station jam and 9:03 of Drums; Other One space is included [9]
- **gd1984-10-17.sbd.miller.32057.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Master Cassette -> ? -> Cassette (Dolby C) // Set 2: SBD -> Master Cassette -> Dat -> CD -> EAC -> SHN [11]. Also: Soundboard release with contributions from Mike Shoun and Jim Powell, with a seamless transition between Discs 2 and 3 [11]
- **gd84-10-17.set2-sbd.ladner.21783.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MC>DAT via J.Powell encoded by C.Ladner. [14]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Meadowlands Arena - October 18, 1984](https://www.dead.net/show/october-18-1984) [30]
